mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, leading to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1150.0 and RSAFS > 480000.0 in the same month
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1150.0 and RSAFS > 480000.0 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases, or the interaction term has a negative or insignificant coefficient in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 95.0 (2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, signaling an impending economic slowdown that triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or the signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.05 in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized growth, combined with rising housing starts, indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 > 2.0 and HOUST > 1150.0 fails to generate positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% and a rise in non-farm payrolls above 200k signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 200.0, or the interaction term has a negative or insignificant coefficient in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) combined with stagnant housing starts indicates a supply-side shock, reducing output and increasing input costs, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 and HOUST < 1100.0, or the interaction term is not significant in a multivariate model.
